item.title: Around 100 health visitors set to end nine-month pay strike
item.body: Around 100 health visitors are set to return to work on Monday 16 November after Unite and Cwm Taf Morgannwg University Health Board reached an agreement in principle to end a nine-month strike over pay grades.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | ⚕️ Around 100 health visitors set to end nine-month pay strike

Around 100 health visitors are set to return to work on Monday 16 November after Unite and Cwm Taf Morgannwg University Health Board reached an agreement in principle to end a nine-month strike over pay grades.

Source: Nation.Cymru | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 13 November, 15:50
